integrity: Self-contained exact proof and standalone exact-arithmetic finite checker. The finite checker is a consistency test, not an infinite proof or a priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled trees only; no weighted or arbitrary offspring models. Classical rooted-forest enumeration is a premise. Single-marked-endpoint degree/distance relations overlap a published result and are not a new contribution. Broader height-degree enumerators may imply the conditional distribution after summation; historical priority for the explicit cubic sign transition remains uncertain.
title: Leaf–distance regression in uniform labeled trees has a cubic turning point
